Labels cover entities returned, anchors, and intermediate endpoints on a required path.
Politician is the graph's person slot. Recognize individual people without inferring political status or graph membership.
Organization covers general organizations; LaborUnion and PAC are specialized organization types.
Bill is a legislative measure; Prop is a ballot proposition, not a Bill.
A vote on a Bill uses a Politician vote relationship to LegislativeEvent and ACTION_ON to Bill.
When a question asks what vote was recorded without specifying an outcome, all three possible vote relationships could be needed; do not predict the recorded outcome.
Article is compiler-owned. Only its topic relationship and title/date filters are classified.
Articles that discuss a policy area use DISCUSSES_TOPIC. Entity policy classification uses ABOUT_TOPIC.
Stored reporting about an entity is automatic and does not imply a semantic claim relationship.
A topic-related element is unnecessary unless it could participate in answering the question.
Each judgment is independent; do not assume any other judgment's answer.

grounding.text:
Diego County supervisor race establishment pick.

Republican gubernatorial candidate Steve Hilton also has a friend in Carl DeMaio, according to Hilton spokesperson Hector Barajas. Steve Hilton appeared on Carl DeMaio daily podcast in the run-up to the June primary.

“Steve Hilton is proud to have the support of Reform California and values Steve Hilton relationship with Carl DeMaio,” Barajas said in a statement. Carl DeMaio group had endorsed Steve Hilton and Chad Bianco Steve Hilton and Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco in the primary.

entries.description: CalMatters reporting on California politics and public policy. Source Articles and their Article Chunks support finding reporting and reported connections among political actors, organizations, and measures.

construction.cypher:
MATCH (role_1:Organization)-[semantic_rel_0:LOBBIED_FOR]->(role_0:Bill)
WHERE role_0.name = $parameter_0 AND role_0.session = $parameter_1
UNWIND coalesce(semantic_rel_0.chunks,[]) AS _chunk_id_0
MATCH (role_1)-[:MENTIONED_IN]->(_chunk_0:Chunk {id:_chunk_id_0})
MATCH (role_0)-[:MENTIONED_IN]->(_chunk_0)
MATCH (_article_0:NewsArticle)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(_chunk_0)
WITH role_0,role_1,semantic_rel_0,collect(DISTINCT _chunk_0.id) AS _chunk_ids_0,collect(DISTINCT _article_0.id) AS _article_ids_0,collect(DISTINCT _chunk_0{.id,.index,.text}) AS _chunk_values_0,collect(DISTINCT properties(_article_0)) AS _article_values_0
RETURN DISTINCT role_0.id AS role_0_id,
       properties(role_0) AS role_0_properties,
       role_1.id AS role_1_id,
       properties(role_1) AS role_1_properties,
       type(semantic_rel_0) AS semantic_relationship_0_relationship,
       {} AS semantic_relationship_0_properties,
       _article_ids_0 AS semantic_relationship_0_article_ids,
       [{kind:'semantic_relationship_0',ids:_chunk_ids_0}] AS evidence_groups,
       [{kind:'semantic_relationship_0',chunks:_chunk_values_0,articles:_article_values_0}] AS hydrated_evidence

pressure to make billionaires and corporations pay more.

citation.title: Cal State faculty push to prevent AI tools from replacing them as schools and staff experiment

grounding.text:
with faculty.

More battles over AI in the workplace

unnamed bill is one of several in California aimed at curbing the role of artificial intelligence in the workplace, but other bills are far more divisive.  Senate Bill 947, would prevent employers from relying solely on AI tools to discipline or dismiss employees. Senate Bill 947 has the support of labor unions and some nonprofits skeptical of generative AI. Business groups oppose Senate Bill 947, including California Chamber of Commerce as well as ride-hail company Lyft.

citation.title: This CA proposition will send $4 billion to a single nonprofit. Who’s behind it?

grounding.text:
could satisfy the stipulations of Proposition 38.

The website supporting Proposition 38 touts Proposition 38 as an effort to award grant dollars to scientists working on drug therapies for incurable diseases, but makes no mention of California Institute for Immunology and Immunotherapy as a likely recipient of half the bond revenue. Gary K. Michelson and the Michelson Center For Public Policyc Policy, donated at least $8.2 million to Yes on Proposition 38 campaign. Meyer Luskin, has given at least $5 million.

      (role_1:LegislativeEvent)-[semantic_rel_1:ACTION_ON]->(role_0:Bill)
WHERE role_0.name = $parameter_0 AND role_0.session = $parameter_1 AND role_2.name = $parameter_2
UNWIND coalesce(semantic_rel_0.chunks,[]) AS _chunk_id_0
MATCH (role_2)-[:MENTIONED_IN]->(_chunk_0:Chunk {id:_chunk_id_0})
MATCH (role_1)-[:MENTIONED_IN]->(_chunk_0)
MATCH (_article_0:NewsArticle)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(_chunk_0)
WITH role_0,role_1,role_2,semantic_rel_0,semantic_rel_1,collect(DISTINCT _chunk_0.id) AS _chunk_ids_0,collect(DISTINCT _article_0.id) AS _article_ids_0,collect(DISTINCT _chunk_0{.id,.index,.text}) AS _chunk_values_0,collect(DISTINCT properties(_article_0)) AS _article_values_0
UNWIND coalesce(semantic_rel_1.chunks,[]) AS _chunk_id_1
MATCH (role_1)-[:MENTIONED_IN]->(_chunk_1:Chunk {id:_chunk_id_1})
MATCH (role_0)-[:MENTIONED_IN]->(_chunk_1)
MATCH (_article_1:NewsArticle)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(_chunk_1)
WITH role_0,role_1,role_2,semantic_rel_0,semantic_rel_1,_chunk_ids_0,_article_ids_0,_chunk_values_0,_article_values_0,collect(DISTINCT _chunk_1.id) AS _chunk_ids_1,collect(DISTINCT _article_1.id) AS _article_ids_1,collect(DISTINCT _chunk_1{.id,.index,.text}) AS _chunk_values_1,collect(DISTINCT properties(_article_1)) AS _article_values_1
RETURN DISTINCT role_0.id AS role_0_id,
       properties(role_0) AS role_0_properties,
       role_1.id AS role_1_id,
       properties(role_1) AS role_1_properties,
       role_2.id AS role_2_id,
       properties(role_2) AS role_2_properties,
       type(semantic_rel_0) AS semantic_relationship_0_relationship,
       {} AS semantic_relationship_0_properties,
       _article_ids_0 AS semantic_relationship_0_article_ids,
       type(semantic_rel_1) AS semantic_relationship_1_relationship,
       {} AS semantic_relationship_1_properties,
       _article_ids_1 AS semantic_relationship_1_article_ids,
       [{kind:'semantic_relationship_0',ids:_chunk_ids_0},{kind:'semantic_relationship_1',ids:_chunk_ids_1}] AS evidence_groups,
       [{kind:'semantic_relationship_0',chunks:_chunk_values_0,articles:_article_values_0},{kind:'semantic_relationship_1',chunks:_chunk_values_1,articles:_article_values_1}] AS hydrated_evidence

selection_guidance: Keep semantic schema elements that could be needed to answer the question.
Labels cover entities returned, anchors, and intermediate endpoints on a required path.
Politician is the graph's person slot. Recognize individual people without inferring political status or graph membership.
Organization covers general organizations; LaborUnion and PAC are specialized organization types.
Bill is a legislative measure; Prop is a ballot proposition, not a Bill.
A vote on a Bill uses a Politician vote relationship to LegislativeEvent and ACTION_ON to Bill.
When a question asks what vote was recorded without specifying an outcome, all three possible vote relationships could be needed; do not predict the recorded outcome.
Article is compiler-owned. Only its topic relationship and title/date filters are classified.
Articles that discuss a policy area use DISCUSSES_TOPIC. Entity policy classification uses ABOUT_TOPIC.
Stored reporting about an entity is automatic and does not imply a semantic claim relationship.
A topic-related element is unnecessary unless it could participate in answering the question.
Each judgment is independent; do not assume any other judgment's answer.

pruning.predicate_family_rule: A relationship fragment survives only when both endpoints are selected and every predicate in that fragment is present. A family union therefore survives only when the filter selected the whole family; single family members remain competing alternatives.
pruning.repeated_peer_rule: Each surviving relationship keeps its single, repeated-source, and repeated-target variants. A peer variant implies both relationship occurrences, repeated roles, and distinctness.

relationship_definitions.ACTION_ON: Connects a legislative event, including a vote event, to the Bill that the event concerns.
relationship_definitions.CAMPAIGN_FOR: Connects a campaign to the person or ballot proposition it targets. This identifies the measure or person associated with a funded campaign.

citation.title: Abortion pills could come to California community college health centers

grounding.text:
with community health providers “as appropriate.”

amendments also broadened what colleges would report to the state, allowing community colleges to count medication abortion provided through outside healthcare providers instead of only those performed at community college health centers.

Assembly Bill 2540 was referred to the Senate Health and Education committees on June 10. After amendments, Assembly Bill 2540 was re-referred July 2 to the Senate Appropriations Committee, where lawmakers will review its fiscal impact.

selection_guidance: Keep semantic schema elements that could be needed to answer the question.
Labels cover entities returned, anchors, and intermediate endpoints on a required path.
Politician is the graph's person slot. Recognize individual people without inferring political status or graph membership.
Organization covers general organizations; LaborUnion and PAC are specialized organization types.
Bill is a legislative measure; Prop is a ballot proposition, not a Bill.
A vote on a Bill uses a Politician vote relationship to LegislativeEvent and ACTION_ON to Bill.
When a question asks what vote was recorded without specifying an outcome, all three possible vote relationships could be needed; do not predict the recorded outcome.

with community health providers “as appropriate.”

amendments also broadened what colleges would report to the state, allowing community colleges to count medication abortion provided through outside healthcare providers instead of only those performed at community college health centers.

Assembly Bill 2540 was referred to the Senate Health and Education committees on June 10. After amendments, Assembly Bill 2540 was re-referred July 2 to the Senate Appropriations Committee, where lawmakers will review its fiscal impact.

relationship_definitions.ABOUT_TOPIC: Connects a Bill or ballot proposition to its policy area; this classifies the measure's subject.

relationship_definitions.ACTION_ON: Connects a legislative event, including a vote event, to the Bill that the event concerns.
relationship_definitions.CAMPAIGN_FOR: Connects a campaign to the person or ballot proposition it targets. This identifies the measure or person associated with a funded campaign.
relationship_definitions.DECLARED_STANCE: Connects a person or organization to a Bill or ballot proposition about which it has explicitly stated a position.
relationship_definitions.DISCUSSES_TOPIC: Connects a stored news article to the policy area it discusses.
relationship_definitions.ENDORSED: Connects a person or organization to a ballot proposition or campaign it publicly backs.
relationship_definitions.FUNDED: Connects an organization to a campaign it is recorded as providing money to.
relationship_definitions.LOBBIED_AGAINST: Connects an organization to a Bill it is recorded as lobbying in opposition to.
relationship_definitions.LOBBIED_FOR: Connects an organization to a Bill it is recorded as lobbying in support of.
relationship_definitions.REFERRED_TO: Connects a Bill to a legislative committee to which it was referred.
relationship_definitions.VOTED_AYE: Connects a person to a legislative event at which their recorded vote was affirmative. It is one possible outcome when retrieving a person's recorded vote.
relationship_definitions.VOTED_NO: Connects a person to a legislative event at which their recorded vote was negative. It is one possible outcome when retrieving a person's recorded vote.
